cases.title: Two issues in one message (reminders + invoice)

output.reply:
Hello Priya,

Thanks for your message. Here is help with both points.

1) SMS reminders not sending
Please check these common causes:
- Message credits: SMS reminders use message credits, and when they run out reminders pause until you top up. Check your balance in Settings → Billing → Message credits. Since this started on a specific day, this is the most likely cause.
- Phone number format: numbers must include the country code (e.g. +44 7700 900000). Numbers without one are skipped.
- Client opt-out: if a client replied STOP, they won't receive further reminders. This shows on their profile.
- Booking timing: appointments booked inside the reminder window (e.g. 1 hour before with a 24-hour reminder) won't get that reminder.

You can see the status of each reminder (sent, failed, or skipped, and why) in Reports → Reminder log. Also check status.slotwise.test for any incidents. If credits are fine and the log shows reminders failing without a clear reason, reply with a couple of example client names and appointment times and we'll investigate further.

2) Invoices with company name and VAT number
All invoices are in Settings → Billing → Invoices, where you can click an invoice to download the PDF. To add your company name (Lotus Yoga Studio Ltd) and VAT number, edit Billing details. Please note that this only applies to future invoices. For corrected copies of past invoices (August and September), please reply with the invoice numbers and our billing team will help you with that.

Best regards,
Slotwise Support

cases.title: Set up deposits for new clients

output.reply:
Hi Chloe,

Yes, you can require a deposit when clients book online. Deposits are paid through Stripe, so you'll need to connect a Stripe account first (you can create a new one during setup).

1. Go to Settings → Payments and click Connect Stripe. Log in to an existing Stripe account or create a new one, then finish Stripe's verification. Payouts start once Stripe has verified your business.
2. Go to Settings → Payments → Deposits and turn on Require deposit. Choose a fixed amount or a percentage of the service price. You can also limit deposits to specific services.

Clients then pay the deposit on your booking page when they book. The rest is paid in person or online after the appointment. Money goes straight to your Stripe account, and Slotwise never holds your funds.

Please note that deposits are included in the Pro plan ($79/month) and above. You can check or change your plan in Settings → Billing → Change plan.

To further reduce no-shows, you can also set a late-cancellation or no-show fee under Settings → Payments → Cancellation policy. Clients save a card when booking and agree to the policy. If they no-show, you open the appointment and click Charge no-show fee. Fees are never charged automatically. Reminders by SMS or WhatsApp (Settings → Reminders) also help.

Best regards,
Slotwise Support

Hi Chloe,

Agar balance zero hai to top up kar lein, reminders dobara chal paRenge.
